newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil to raise state pensions by 7.76 pct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil to raise state pensions by 7.76 pct.

text.p: The Brazilian government will raise state pensions by 7.76 percent on June 1, officials at the Presidential Palace said.
The officials said a decree on the increase would be published in the Official Journal.
The government raised on May 1 the minimum wage by 7.14 percent to 120 reais, but left a decision on whether or not to increase state pensions till later.
The raise affects pensions for hundreds of thousands of retirees in Brazil's massive public sector.
